headline: Medicine Storage in Ukraine Simplified: How Stocks Will Be Protected From Attacks
summary: Under martial law, Ukrainian companies will be able to move medicine stocks more quickly to additional warehouses. The measure aims to reduce the risk of shortages from attacks.
why: Pharmaceutical distribution and storage are critical to supply chains, and wartime rules affect how drug distributors manage inventory risk.
